text:
Type: tall bookcase with glass doors
Use: storing and displaying books, china and collections behind glass; living room, home office, dining room
Style: classic, traditional, contemporary
Materials: brown stained ash veneer, framed clear glass doors, small knobs
Colors: medium warm brown, clear glass
Shape: tall rectangular cabinet with two full-height framed glass doors, horizontal crossbar at mid-height, adjustable shelves visible inside, plinth base, substantial visual weight
Feel: warm, orderly, scholarly, refined
Goes with: warm wood, leather armchairs, green or navy walls, brass lamps; classic studies, libraries and traditional living rooms
